description: Drive a single pull request to merge-ready across all six criteria (sync, CI, inline comments, conversation, threads, bot re-review of the head commit), then smart-merge it. Source-agnostic library skill invoked by the /tm, /issues, /fix-pr, and /fix-develop commands and by marathon teammates. TRIGGER when a command or agent needs the PR review-to-green loop or the smart-merge (stale-bot-CR dismissal, auto-merge criteria, UNSTABLE/UNKNOWN handling, merge ordering), or when the user asks to take a PR to green/merge it.
